title: A Spare Key With a Neighbour
transcript:
When a plumber needed to inspect a leak in my kitchen, the only available appointment fell during an important meeting at work. I first considered cancelling the inspection, but the water mark on the ceiling below was growing. My neighbour offered to let the plumber in using my spare key. I was grateful, although I realised that simply handing over the key would not be enough.

We agreed on the name of the company and the expected arrival time. I told the company that my neighbour would meet its worker, and I left a note explaining where the leak had appeared. I also moved the boxes from under the sink, so the plumber would not have to ask my neighbour to handle my belongings.

That morning, the company called to say its worker would be an hour late. My neighbour needed to collect her grandson by then. Instead of asking her to change her plans, I contacted my manager and arranged to take my lunch break earlier. I arrived home just before the plumber and thanked my neighbour for being willing to help.

The spare key was useful even though the original plan changed. More importantly, our discussion had made everyone's responsibilities clear. We agreed that keeping a key should never mean being available at any time. I now check both the appointment details and my neighbour's schedule before asking for help, rather than assuming that living next door makes an arrangement easy.

questions.prompt: Why could the speaker not attend the original appointment easily?
options: The company had not explained the problem.
The appointment conflicted with an important work meeting.
The speaker had already left for a holiday.
The neighbour was using the kitchen.
questions.answer: The appointment conflicted with an important work meeting.
questions.explanation: 管道工唯一可预约的时间与说话者工作中的重要会议冲突。

questions.prompt: What did the speaker do to make the inspection easier?
options: Asked the neighbour to repair the ceiling first.
Removed the company name from the note.
Cleared the boxes from beneath the sink.
Moved the appointment to the next month.
questions.answer: Cleared the boxes from beneath the sink.
questions.explanation: 说话者搬开水槽下的箱子，避免让邻居在检查时处理自己的物品。

questions.prompt: Why did the neighbour become unavailable for the delayed appointment?
options: She had to attend the speaker's meeting.
She had lost the spare key.
She was waiting for a different company.
She needed to collect her grandson.
questions.answer: She needed to collect her grandson.
questions.explanation: 工人迟到一小时后，邻居刚好需要去接孙子，无法继续代为等候。

questions.prompt: What agreement did the neighbours reach afterwards?
options: Keeping a spare key did not mean being available whenever needed.
The neighbour would handle all future repair appointments.
The speaker should never accept help from others.
Every appointment should be cancelled if its time changed.
questions.answer: Keeping a spare key did not mean being available whenever needed.
questions.explanation: 双方明确，保管备用钥匙并不意味着邻居必须随时有空帮忙。
